privacy.intro: At Granja Mari Pepa we take the privacy of our customers and users very seriously.

s2.title: 2. Purpose of Processing
s2.content: We process the information you provide in order to provide the requested service, perform billing and send commercial communications related to our products and services.

s3.title: 3. Data Retention
s3.content: The data provided will be kept as long as the commercial relationship is maintained or for the years necessary to comply with legal obligations.

s4.title: 4. Legitimation
s4.content: The legal basis for the processing of your data is the execution of the contract for the provision of services and/or sale of products.

s5.title: 5. Recipients
s5.content: The data will not be transferred to third parties except in cases where there is a legal obligation.

s6.title: 6. Rights
s6.content: You have the right to obtain confirmation as to whether Granja Mari Pepa is processing your personal data, therefore you have the right to access your personal data, rectify inaccurate data or request its deletion when the data is no longer necessary.
